title: MURANO: Design, Run, and Reproduce Mechanistic Interpretability Experiments as Composable Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2608.30662v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents Murano, an open source framework for designing, running, and reproducing mechanistic interpretability studies of large language models, intended for researchers across disciplines. These studies often combine loading, recording, attribution, intervention, and evaluation, while existing libraries tend to focus on different parts of this workflow. As a result, researchers using several libraries may need to adapt outputs from one for use by another. To bridge this gap, Murano represents operations from these five areas as composable steps. Steps exchange named result artifacts and declare the inputs they require and the outputs they produce. A pipeline executes its steps in the order supplied, and Murano uses canonical addresses when component identities pass between operations. translated_title: MURANO：以可组合流水线的方式设计、运行和复现大语言模型的机制可解释性实验
translated_abstract: 本文提出了 Murano，一个用于设计、运行和复现大语言模型机制可解释性研究的开源框架，面向跨学科的研究人员。这类研究通常组合了加载、记录、归因、干预和评估等操作，而现有的库往往只关注该工作流程中的不同部分。因此，同时使用多个库的研究人员可能需要将一个库的输出适配为另一个库可用的输入。为了弥合这一差距，Murano 将这五个领域的操作表示为可组合的步骤。步骤之间通过命名的结果工件进行交换，并声明它们所需的输入和所产生的输出。流水线按照给定的顺序执行各个步骤，当组件标识在不同操作之间传递时，Murano 使用规范地址。Murano 构建在现有的可解释性和机器学习库之上。我们通过对两个已有研究的复现来演示 Murano。
tldr: Murano 是一个开源框架，将大语言模型机制可解释性研究中的加载、记录、归因、干预和评估操作统一为可组合、可复现的流水线步骤，解决了现有多个可解释性库之间输入输出难以衔接的碎片化问题。
en_tdlr: Murano is an open-source framework that unifies loading, recording, attribution, intervention, and evaluation in mechanistic interpretability research as composable, reproducible pipeline steps, bridging the interoperability gap among existing interpretability libraries.
